notes.title: Major Update #4
notes.notes:
Hey all!



We’ve been radio silent for a while now, but we haven’t been slacking off! This patch brings a mix of important fixes, quality-of-life polish, and new content. Enjoy!
[hr][/hr]Fixes
Fixed issue where Hi-Fi could be used during blackout

Fixed (removed) the ability to open containers in Ellie’s room (players could soft lock the game by adding key items in those containers)

Fixed teleportation issue – the character was teleporting in the Hallway instead of the Golden Room after being killed by Mr. Blob

Fixed Mawie Level 3 Gate issue – the gate trigger would remain open after dying and resetting the game

Fixed Mawie enemy bee behavior – bee now resets properly after dying and resetting the game

German localization fixes – special thanks to Markus “Das M” N for going the extra mile in helping us resolve localization issues and providing additional QA!

Improved PC windows interaction

Fridge Interaction (off-putting smell) polish – new animations, new text, and improved flow

Added Doll Jingle Note to Tina Doll when inspecting her in the Tea Room near the piano (previously the doll jingle would not trigger after the kids’ disappearance, causing confusion)

Tina plays the secret Sound event when you don't have her in your inventory

Added notification that half of a modular key is added to the inventory when spare keys are inspected

Added confirmation before Ivan confrontation – players are now asked if they want to enter the final confrontation

Added Tina sound when entering a secret zone - she will laugh to let you know you can inspect her or drop her

Added “Hole in the Wall” Tina secret notification
[hr][/hr]Content🕳️Hole in the Wall
This new content can be accessed at any time once you have access to the Guest Hallways. It features the following:

New lore available

A second conversation with Henry

A new Close-Up interaction

A new way to die

An explanation of a new mechanic
🕯️New Candle Mechanic
You can now light candles via the inventory. To do this:
[olist]
Select a candle in your inventory

Select the lighter

A new lit candle item will be added to your inventory
[/olist]
This mechanic works in conjunction with the Cobwebs mechanic.
🕸️Cobweb Mechanic
Cobwebs can appear in specific locations within the house and may cover entire entrances. These need to be burned in order to progress.
✨Steam Achievements
We’ve added the first round of achievements to the game!

Note: A number of achievements are still not yet implemented. They will appear in Steam as “7 hidden achievements remaining” and will be added in a future update.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you all so much for your patience and support. Feel free to join our Discord or post on the community forums with any issues or questions you may have.



Sincerely,
The Scared Stupid Inc. Team

notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
Hey all!

It’s time for another update for Midnight Special!

This one focuses mostly on fixing issues, polishing existing content, and addressing a few more serious problems that slipped past us.

First up, here are the new features:



Juke Box Player

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098144/ed60cd556175abb7bfd7d2b8fe0812fdfeb2140d.gif"]

Jukebox – You can now add and play vinyls you find in the game at any time

1 new song added: "Loaded Gun", alongside a band bio and album art

Added the ability to sit in the beanbag and listen to music (new animations)

Added a sound snapshot that muffles the music when outside the Rumpus Room

The Reload Perk is still disabled until the Weapon Update



Family Portrait (Close-Up)

The portrait now changes dynamically based on the player's actions (e.g., finding the shotgun, the necklace, as well as sanity—all are reflected in the close-up)

This close-up is active when the kids and Jon Sr. are missing from the portrait, and only Shelly is visible

And now, the issues (bolded = serious issues that affected gameplay):

Simplified Kitchen Fridge Interaction - Player no longer needs to use the lighter to trigger the Henry Sequence

Added snapback to organ pieces in the organ puzzle, ensuring they don't get stuck

Fixed guest room trigger that required the player to walk in order to trigger the Void scripted event

Fixed issue where having the lighter on while the run prompt appears would softlock the game

Fixed issue where the player could not run after dying/game over in Mawie

Fixed/removed the ability to drop Tina (the doll) in puzzles and closeups

Fixed issue where connecting a controller would make the game mouse stop functioning

Fixed logic puzzle issue where picking up an organ puzzle piece and placing it into a drawer would cause the organ puzzle to softlock

Fixed mouse teleport issue after placing cheese

Computer UI localization supplement

Fixed Tina teleport issue

Fixed Sarah teleport issue that caused duplication of dialogue/waking up on the couch twice

Fixed dialogue duplication (interacting with TV and then loading a game save)

Thank you all so much for your patience and support. Feel free to join our Discord or post on the community forums with any issues or questions you may have.



Sincerely,

The Scared Stupid Inc. Team

notes.title: Major Update #2
notes.notes:
Hey all!

It's time for another major update for Midnight Special!

We've been hard at work, and we're excited to announce that this update contains a new objective that leans a little bit more into body horror — I hope you guys aren't too squeamish.

In addition to the aforementioned objective, we’ve also added new localized languages, and we've polished and fixed several issues!



New Content:

New Room: The Golden Room (This room allows the player to go back to sleep at any time and explore the dream sequences — this design will be expanded in future updates.)

New Mechanic: Pinch (This new inventory item allows you to wake up from a nightmare at any time — available after the prologue.)

New Puzzle: The Organ/Salt Puzzle (The Salt inventory item is now part of a puzzle which must be completed in order to progress the story.)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098144/556e56c39ffeb8b9e38c8b3d7b72135c3d6a5a50.gif"]

New Interactions/Dialogue: Bob's Tenant (Back by popular request, Bob's Tenant is back with some new quips.)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098144/5c3580904a4d9d06b5e26f237ed11eba599276d4.gif"]

New Objectives (Linked to the Salt Puzzle.)

New Tina the Doll hints added (Salt Puzzle)

Various sound/FX improvements (Documents now have sound cues when they are opened or updated.)

Localization:

We've added 4 new languages

Korean

Portuguese

French

German

Fixes/Polish:

Pick-up items and documents pop-ups should be more consistent and should notify the player.

Various localization issues have been fixed.

Tina the Doll polish.

Various sound/FX issues fixed/polished.



Known issues we're working on:

Currently, if you interact with the TV and then load a save, a piece of dialogue repeats itself after load — we're currently looking into fixing this.

Some players may occasionally encounter repeated dialogue text in the Golden Room. We’ve identified the cause and will fix it in the next update.

There is also a known issue where, after interacting with Tina the Doll, she may not disappear, and the diary you receive may not show up in the inventory. We’ve tracked down the cause and will include a fix in the next update.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. If you need further assistance, please feel free to reach out to us through Discord or Steam community!



Thank you all so much for your patience and support. Feel free to join our Discord or post on the community forums with any issues or questions you may have.



Sincerely,

The Scared Stupid Inc. Team

notes.title: Major Update #1
notes.notes:
Hi all!

No, your eyes do not deceive you — we’re back, and we’ve brought a major update with us!

First off, please accept our sincere apologies to anyone who encountered game-breaking bugs that hindered progression. We’ve been hard at work these past few weeks fixing, testing, and also adding new content to the game — as promised. 

Temporarily Removed:

 Reload perk: Currently being reworked along with the shotgun and some upcoming surprises — so it’s temporarily inaccessible.
 Vinyl player


Here’s a list of issues we’ve addressed:

Issues Fixed:

 Logic issue after death load: Fixed a major bug where loading the game after dying would break event logic. This was the most time-consuming issue to resolve, and we’re hopeful there are no more occurrences. If you do encounter any logic problems, please let us know — we’ll hotfix it quickly.
 Non-16:9 aspect ratio support: This fix addresses issues experienced by users with ultrawide monitors or non-16:9 aspect ratios. Midnight Special runs at a base internal resolution of 240x135, scaled 8x. Ultrawide scaling caused incorrect UI interactions and made parts of the game unplayable. Our temporary fix detects non-standard resolutions and defaults to 1080p Windowed mode on ultrawide setups. We’ll work on a better long-term solution — thanks for your patience!
 Mawie logic fixes
 Bathroom lighter issue resolved
 Typo and dialogue corrections: We’re currently doing a full text/interactions pass for further polish.
 Sanity menu not showing after load: Fixed.
 Various menu improvements
 Other small fixes and improvements


New Features:

 New Save System: You can now save the game at any time and from any location. This feature is triggered in the kitchen after the first phone call (interact with the cigarette pack).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098144/fe74907e0d297ffaff04f8addd4240df881e6553.gif
 New Mechanic – Tina (the doll): Tina now acts as a compass for secrets. She becomes active after the dream sequence, when interacting in Jon’s Room.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098144/3a8485df325334f8b5c10dd47554f6d6ca2e8e2a.gif
 Reduced tripping frequency during low Sanity moments
 New closeups to clarify the door puzzle: Added new visual cues (e.g., sketches and canvas in Shelly’s Studio).
 New diary entries: Additional lore and explanations for mechanics like tripping.


Thank you all so much for your patience and support. Feel free to join our Discord or post on the community forums with any issues or questions you may have.

Sincerely,
The Scared Stupid Inc. Team

notes.title: Next Major Patch Drops Next Week!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Sorry for the radio silence this week! We've been hard at work fixing many of the issues reported since our Early Access launch. We want to thank you all for your patience and give you a quick rundown of what we’ve fixed and what’s coming next week:

Fixes and improvements:


 Major issue where death/save/load caused game logic to break – fixed
 Unable to pick up objects after loading or dying – fixed
 A new temporary Save System has been added and is currently being tested
 Cleaner, smoother logic throughout the entire game
 20:9 and 21:9 resolution support – fixed
 Various typo corrections
 Localization fixes


Coming soon (next patch and beyond):

 
 Scene switching inconsistencies
 Pop-up inconsistencies (item pickups, objectives)
 Controller and Steam Deck support
 macOS port
 New content?? 👀


Thanks again for your patience. We know your time and money are valuable, and we truly appreciate that you’ve chosen to spend some of both on our game.

Have a wonderful day,
The Scared Stupid Inc. Team
